verdict.rationale: Galileo docs confirm an alerting feature — "get alerted whenever unexpected things happen," citing cost spikes and model degradation as examples — showing the core alerting-on-metrics capability exists. However, the evidence pack never specifies alert triggers for error rates or eval-score drops explicitly, nor does it mention delivery via Slack, PagerDuty, or email. Missing for 10: explicit error-rate/eval-score-drop alert triggers, and documented Slack/PagerDuty/email notification integrations.
